objectives.title: Lawful Processing Governance
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding lawful data handling procedures.
criteria: Provisions specifying the legal basis for processing.
Writings defining fairness standards applied to data subjects.
Requirements for transparent processing notifications.

objectives.title: Purpose Specification
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding data processing boundaries.
criteria: Specification of explicit processing purposes.
Prohibitions against incompatible secondary processing operations.
Protocols for public interest research processing exceptions.

objectives.title: Data Minimisation Standards
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding data volume restrictions.
criteria: Clauses restricting data collection to adequate limits.
Provisions enforcing data processing relevance.
Writings limiting stored data strictly to necessary operational requirements.

objectives.title: Data Accuracy Management
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding data precision maintenance.
criteria: Procedures ensuring data precision.
Schedules governing systematic record updates.
Mechanisms executing immediate inaccurate data erasure.
Processes executing prompt inaccurate data rectification.

objectives.title: Storage Limitation Protocols
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding data retention boundaries.
criteria: Defined data retention periods tied to the purposes for which the data is processed.
Mechanisms for deleting or anonymising personal data once it is no longer needed for those purposes.
Recognition of exceptions allowing longer storage solely for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes.
Required technical and organisational safeguards for personal data retained under those extended-storage exceptions.

objectives.title: Data Security Safeguards
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding data protection measures.
criteria: Technical and organisational measures to prevent unauthorised or unlawful processing.
Measures preventing accidental loss of personal data.
Measures preventing accidental destruction of personal data.
Measures preventing accidental damage to personal data.

objectives.title: Accountability Documentation
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding compliance demonstration.
criteria: Protocols establishing controller responsibility.
Provisions mandating compliance recordkeeping.
Procedures demonstrating adherence through verifiable audits.
